newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list options on K2, others, Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list options on K2, others, Nov 26.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said on Friday it will list options on shares of K2 Inc, Medical Resources Inc and Sync Research Inc on November 26.
K2 options will have opening strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30, with initial expiration months of December, January, February and May.
Park Avenue Securities will be the specialist.
Medical Resources options will have opening strikes of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2. Initial expirations will be in December, January, April and July.
For Sync Research, the options will open with strikes of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2 and expirations in December, January, April and July.
Susquehanna Investment Group will be the specialist for Medical Resources and Sync Research options.
